about: Documents of «Студия теста» past the old caps (migration 20261107090500_studio_pages.sql: 2100 blocks, 512 KB of jsonb text) and the first rule meldy_private.test_doc_ok gives each (null: valid). The exam, the other exam and the owner are those of test_doc_cases.json; items are 1997 more questions of that exam (with its 3 the exam holds 2000, the most, MC007), and a question block may point at either list. frontend/src/lib/studio/doc.test.ts checks docProblems on every case; supabase/tests/local/studio_pages_run.sh runs them with the cases of test_doc_cases.json through test_docs_parity.sql. «sizes» are documents made by a recipe (both sides make the same one): «texts» text blocks (ids size000001…) of 4000 «я», then one text block (id sizepad0) of «ya» times «я» and «a» times «a», on a page titled «Размер» (layout one_page, the plain theme of the cases, no bands); «bytes» is octet_length(doc::text) when given, and «expect» what test_doc_save answers (22023 size, or null: saved) and what docProblems adds.
